column1: # Layer C1cs: each case's seconds, its build and its pico reference's, as capability_cost_gate.py
# prints them (`<id>: <N>s`). The hosted lane is planned over these (capability_cost_gate.py,
# "The hosted shards"); they decide the balance of its shards, never which case is built.
# Read 2026-11-23 from one `--measure` of every case in the gate's order on four cores of a build
# machine, an empty artifact root and a warm cargo home: 1,218 s together, where the one hosted job
# of run 45051019628 read 1,013 s. The first case of a run also builds the dependencies; refresh
# the rows from a hosted shard's lines, which carry that cost where the plan put it.
